text: My main symptom is Episodic cough and shortness of breath. I also have Cough worsens with exertion and at night, History of recent upper respiratory tract infection symptoms such as fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pyelonephritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious Cough (likely due to prior viral upper respiratory tract infection). Note: The mention of "Pyelonephritis" by your previous doctor appears to be a significant error, as that is a kidney infection and does not present with cough or shortness of breath. While we wait for the Chest X-Ray results, have you noticed any swelling in your legs or any changes in your urine color?
